front: Single place to see failed runs of pipelines, notebooks and dataflows
back: Monitor hub (Job runs), filtered by Failed status. Chỉ hiện item bạn có quyền xem.

ref.label: Monitor job runs in the Monitor hub

front: Query 30 days of item logs with KQL and build dashboards
back: Workspace monitoring: logs go to the monitoring eventhouse, 30-day default retention. Collection mặc định tắt và không backfill.

front: Which item consumed the most CU at 09:10?
back: Capacity Metrics app, Timepoint page (30-second timepoint). App không có alert; dùng capacity events để alert.

ref.label: What is the Microsoft Fabric Capacity Metrics app

front: Spark error HTTP 430 TooManyRequestsForCapacity
back: All Spark cores in use. Pipeline and scheduled jobs queue up to 24 hours; interactive notebooks do not. Capacity đang throttled thì job mới bị reject.

ref.label: Concurrency limits and queueing in Apache Spark for Fabric

front: Free email when a scheduled job fails
back: Schedule failure emails in the Monitor hub or job scheduler. Không áp dụng cho manual run và chưa hỗ trợ semantic model.

ref.label: Set up job alerts in the Monitor hub

front: Alert on Started or Succeeded job events, or run a notebook as the action
back: Activator rule on job events. Activator tính CU khi rule đang chạy.

ref.label: Set up job alerts in the Monitor hub

front: One alert rule for all failed pipelines in a workspace
back: Workspace monitoring + KQL Queryset on ItemJobEventLogs + Activator. Activator phải poll dày hơn cửa sổ query.

front: Refresh an Import semantic model right after the load
back: Semantic model refresh activity after the load in the same pipeline; pick tables or partitions. Mặc định full refresh và Wait on completion bật.

front: Direct Lake model does not show new Delta rows
back: Refresh (framing) the model or enable automatic updates. Framing chỉ cập nhật metadata trong vài giây.

front: Dataflow Gen2 refresh failed, need Mashup engine logs
back: Recent runs > Download detailed logs (kept 28 days). Qua gateway thì bật Admin consent for gateway diagnostics.

ref.label: View refresh history and monitor your dataflows

front: Pipeline activity fails on transient errors
back: Enable retries on the activity; retry interval default 30 seconds. Timeout mặc định 12 giờ, tối đa 7 ngày.

front: Warehouse error 24556 update conflict
back: Snapshot isolation detects write-write conflicts at table level; retry the failed transaction. MERGE chỉ insert vẫn có thể conflict.

front: Update policy failed, find the error
back: .show ingestion failures | where OriginatesFromUpdatePolicy == true. Lỗi hay gặp là schema output không khớp target.

front: Update policy must not leave source and target inconsistent
back: Set IsTransactional to true (default false). Policy lỗi thì cả source và target không nhận data.

front: Eventstream Backlogged input events and Watermark delay rising
back: Raise the Event throughput level (Low < 10, Medium 10 to 100, High > 100 MB/s). Event Hubs dưới 4 partition bị giới hạn bởi partition.

ref.label: Configure settings for a Fabric eventstream

front: Did the warehouse query read from OneLake (cold start)?
back: queryinsights.exec_requests_history, data_scanned_remote_storage_mb > 0. Đừng đo hiệu năng bằng lần chạy đầu.

ref.label: Performance guidelines in Fabric Data Warehouse

front: Spark V-Order default in a new workspace
back: Off: new workspaces use the writeHeavy profile (spark.sql.parquet.vorder.default=false). Warehouse thì V-Order bật mặc định.

front: OPTIMIZE dbo.t ZORDER BY (a, b) VORDER runs in which order?
back: Bin compaction, then Z-Order, then V-Order. VORDER ép V-Order bất kể session hay table setting.

front: Filter columns change, high cardinality, no partition rewrite
back: Liquid clustering: ALTER TABLE ... CLUSTER BY, applied on OPTIMIZE. Đổi key thì OPTIMIZE FULL (Runtime 2.0).

front: VACUUM default retention
back: 7 days (168 hours); shorter fails unless spark.databricks.delta.retentionDurationCheck.enabled=false. DRY RUN để xem trước file sẽ xóa.

front: Fabric equivalent of Databricks Photon
back: Native execution engine (Velox + Apache Gluten), Runtime 1.3 and 2.0; enable on the environment Acceleration tab or spark.native.enabled. Không tự bật.

ref.label: Native execution engine for Fabric Data Engineering

front: Warehouse cache for repeated identical SELECTs
back: Result set caching, on by default; result_cache_hit = 2 means hit. Không cache CTAS, cross-database, GETDATE().

front: Keep 2 years, fast queries on last 14 days in an eventhouse
back: Retention softdelete = 730d, caching hot = 14d. Caching phải nhỏ hơn hoặc bằng retention.
